Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: The Heartbeat message carries no data; it is simply a message header with msgType of 1.

Message.Name: Order Add Message
Message.Description: The Order Add message is published when order quantity is posted to the order book for a particular security. This message is only applicable to continuous trading.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy Order, 2 = Sell Order

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares being added to the book

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The price of the order

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Unique order reference number for the day

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: The Order Cancel message is published when a visible order is removed from the book. This message is only applicable to continuous trading.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Unique order reference number for the day

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Order Modify Message
Message.Description: The Order Modify message is published when a visible order is modified by the client (change of price and/or quantity). The order reference number remains the same on order modification. This message is only applicable to continuous trading.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares remaining in the book

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The price of the order

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Unique order reference number for the day

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Quote Add/Replace Message
Message.Description: The Quote Add/Replace message is published when a quote is available for a particular security.

Field.Name: traderID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the market maker quoting

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: bidQuantity
Field.Description: Number of available bid shares

Field.Name: bidPrice
Field.Description: The price of the bid shares

Field.Name: offerQuantity
Field.Description: Number of available offer shares

Field.Name: offerPrice
Field.Description: The price of the offer shares

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Quote Cancel Message
Message.Description: The Quote Cancel message is published when a quote is removed for a particular security. The quote may have been cancelled by the trading Member or by the Aquis support team or the market may have closed.

Field.Name: traderID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the originator of the quote

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the security

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Whenever an order trades, partially or fully, a Trade message is published.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: tradeType
Field.Description: Code identifying type of trade, see section 3.6.2 for values

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares traded

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The execution price

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number, for tradeType 1 (visible)

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference number

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Field.Name: Binary MMT
Field.Description: See section 3.6.1 for values

Message.Name: Trade Report Message
Message.Description: Whenever a new trade report is submitted to AQSE, a Trade Report message is published.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: tradeType
Field.Description: Code identifying type of trade, see section 3.6.2 for values

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares traded

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The execution price

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade report reference number

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: System received timestamp

Field.Name: Binary MMT
Field.Description: See section 3.6.1 for values

Field.Name: transactTime
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction occurred

Message.Name: Trade Report Modify Message
Message.Description: Whenever a previously published trade report is modified, a Trade Report Modify message is published. Members can modify trades for up to five business days from the day on which the trade was reported.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: tradeType
Field.Description: Code identifying type of trade, see section 3.6.2 for values

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares traded

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The execution price

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade report reference number

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: System received timestamp

Field.Name: Binary MMT
Field.Description: See section 3.6.1 for values

Field.Name: transactTime
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction occurred

Field.Name: origTradeRef
Field.Description: Previous accepted trade report message (not necessarily the initial trade report message) reference number

Field.Name: origTimestamp
Field.Description: Previous accepted trade report message (not necessarily the initial trade report message) timestamp of market data event

Message.Name: Trade Report Cancel Message
Message.Description: Whenever a previously published trade report is cancelled, a Trade Report Cancel message is published. Members can cancel trades for up to five business days from the day on which the trade was reported.

Field.Name: origSecurityID
Field.Description: Previous accepted trade report message (not necessarily the initial trade report message) numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: origTradeType
Field.Description: Previous accepted trade report message (not necessarily the initial trade report message) code identifying type of trade, see section 3.6.2 for values

Field.Name: origQuantity
Field.Description: Previous accepted trade report message (not necessarily the initial trade report message) number of shares traded

Field.Name: origPrice
Field.Description: Previous accepted trade report message (not necessarily the initial trade report message) execution price

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade report reference number

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: System received timestamp

Field.Name: Binary MMT
Field.Description: See section 3.6.1 for values

Field.Name: transactTime
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction occurred

Field.Name: origTradeRef
Field.Description: Previous accepted trade report message (not necessarily the initial trade report message) reference number

Field.Name: origTimestamp
Field.Description: Previous accepted trade report message (not necessarily the initial trade report message) timestamp of market data event

Field.Name: origTransactTime
Field.Description: Date and time when the original transaction occurred

Message.Name: Trade Bust Message
Message.Description: If a trade has been declared erroneous by AQSE then a Trade Bust message is published. This message is only applicable to order generated trades.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares of the original trade

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The execution price of the original trade

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference of the busted trade

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Field.Name: Binary MMT
Field.Description: See section 3.6.1 for values

Message.Name: Security Statistics Message
Message.Description: The Security Statistics message is published to disseminate the opening and closing prices of a security.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: Price of security

Field.Name: priceType
Field.Description: 2 = Opening Price, 5 = Closing Price

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Trader Definition Message
Message.Description: A series of Trader Definition messages are published pre-market to identify the quote originators.

Field.Name: traderID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant trader

Field.Name: senderID
Field.Description: SenderID of the trader

Message.Name: Tick Table Data Message
Message.Description: A series of Tick Table Data messages are published pre-market to specify the dynamic tick tables and static ticks that apply to the securities traded on AQSE.

Field.Name: tickTableID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier for this tick table or static tick

Field.Name: name
Field.Description: Short name

Field.Name: threshold
Field.Description: The price threshold at which this tick data applies

Field.Name: tickSize
Field.Description: The tick size (price increment)

Message.Name: Security Definition Message
Message.Description: A series of Security Definition messages are published pre-market to identify the securities traded on AQSE (those relevant to the particular feed e.g. Euronext securities).

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: UMTF
Field.Description: This field is not applicable to AQSE

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN for the security

Field.Name: currency
Field.Description: Trading currency for the security

Field.Name: MIC
Field.Description: MIC for the security's market of listing

Field.Name: tickTableId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier for this security's tick table

Message.Name: Security Status Message
Message.Description: The Security Status message is published when the trading status of a security changes or when there is a change to the status of the market on AQSE to which the security belongs.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: tradingStatus
Field.Description: Possible values: 1 = Active, 2 = Halted, 3 = Suspended. See notes below

Field.Name: marketFlags
Field.Description: Market status flags

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Aod Update Message
Message.Description: During the AoD this message is used to publish the indicative price and indicative matched volume. The first AoD update message signals the start of an auction.

Field.Name: securityID
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: indicativePrice
Field.Description: Indicative auction price

Field.Name: matchVol
Field.Description: Indicative matched volume

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event
